mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `CHAT_MESSAGE` (ID, CONTENT, CREATE_AT, UPDATE_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.CHAT_ID as chatId , c.ID as userId , u.NICKNAME as sender , c.CONTENT as content , ( SELECT iu.UPLOAD_PATH FROM TALK_IMAGE ti JOIN IMAGE_UPLOAD iu ON iu.UPLOAD_ID = ti.UPLOAD_ID WHERE ti.CHAT_ID = c.CHAT_ID ORDER BY ti.TALK_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) as imageUrl , DATE_FORMAT(c.CREATE_AT, '%H:%i') as time FROM `CHAT_MESSAGE` c JOIN `USER` u ON c.ID = u.ID ORDER BY c.CHAT_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
